stories.title: Hawarden High School A-level students secure university places and apprenticeships
stories.summary: Students at Hawarden High School collected their A-level results on Thursday, with places confirmed at Imperial College London and degree apprenticeships with Airbus and Grant Thornton. stories.title: Man, 37, charged with domestic violence offences in Buckley
stories.summary: A man from Buckley has been charged with assault occasioning actual bodily harm and intentional strangulation.
